title: 瑞银王蔚：二季报金融领跑，科技盈利上修，市场分化明显
speaker: James Wang

segments.en: UBS has been tracking everything they've been saying. Look, overall when it comes to tech, financials that actually has been leading some of the growth that we've been seeing.
segments.zh: 瑞银一直在跟踪企业财报。总体来看，科技和金融板块确实引领了增长。

segments.en: James, it's great to have you back. Really, what do you make of what's your report card when it comes to China earning so far?
segments.zh: 王蔚，欢迎回来。你如何评价目前中国企业的财报表现？

segments.en: Yeah, so definitely financials have been leading away in the second quarter. It's been somewhat capital markets led. Banks earnings have stabilized. We've seen a bit of upgrade as well. Their revenue growth is actually up 9% year-on-year because net interest margin normalization.
segments.zh: 二季度金融板块确实领跑，主要受资本市场驱动。银行盈利企稳，还出现了一些上修。由于净息差正常化，营收同比增长9%。

segments.en: Tech is still the spotlight for me. For the last 3 months, tech is still the sector that's seen the most earnings upgrades. So, I think it's still a very binary kind of market. IE, the consumer sector is still a lackluster, but the tech-related, the upstream sectors and also financials are the ones to highlight.
segments.zh: 科技仍是我关注的焦点。过去三个月，科技板块的盈利上修最多。市场呈现明显的二元分化：消费板块表现平淡，但科技相关、上游行业和金融板块值得关注。

segments.en: It's a hardware, specifically. Hardware. AI-related hardware. So, if it's consumer electronics-related, actually it gets impact because of high memory prices. So, it's also very divergent between hardware tech sector.
segments.zh: 具体来说是硬件，AI相关硬件。消费电子相关会受到内存价格高企的影响，所以硬件科技板块内部也有分化。
